_provenance: Inputs derived from tests/fixtures/composer/account-basis/total_stats.json + tests/fixtures/composer/v3-audit/symphony_stats_meta.json (captured-from-producer 2026-06-04). Tests get_portfolio_today_change_account_basis (today-change B-2 fix, mirrors get_portfolio_cumulative_return_account_basis). Expected values are DERIVED from inputs using the formula — never hardcoded from the producer.
_formula: guard_delta_vw = vw_tc.dry_run - vw_tc.if_held; invested_frac = symphony_value_sum / account_value; dry_run_account = account_if_held_tc + guard_delta_vw * invested_frac

scenario_untriggered._description: Zero guard divergence: vw_tc.dry_run == vw_tc.if_held. Expected: result.dry_run == portfolio_tc (no phantom alpha). vw_if_held is the hypothetical VW symphony-basis today-change (differs from portfolio_tc because cash dilutes the account denominator).

scenario_real_guard._description: Non-zero guard divergence: symphony exited, bot outperformed if-held on VW basis. Expected: guard alpha is scaled by invested_frac so it is expressed on account basis.

scenario_none_dry_run._description: dry_run=None (no shadow history). Expected: result is {if_held: portfolio_tc, dry_run: None}.

scenario_meaningful_cash._description: 30% uninvested cash (invested_frac=0.70). Guard delta must be proportionally attenuated — not just marginally (top-level fixture has invested_frac~0.998, only 0.16% cash). Uses its own account_value/symphony_value_sum so the 30%-cash invariant is unambiguous. _guard_delta_vw and _invested_frac encoded for test derivation — never hardcode the expected result.
